limits: Four square footprints, astcenc3.3 medium, source RGB8 and ResNet18 are project reconstructions
Original talk candidate set, hyperparameters, corpus and published performance are not reproduced
Single final encoding retains quality violations without re-encoding
Model is uncalibrated; probability calibration is a separate experiment
Input profile, metric, encoder and timing differ from the Unity LITE baseline
Preprocessing, inference and final encoding are timed; setup and verification are separate
Classification and bytes do not establish equal-quality production acceptance
Fixed-footprint offline candidate times include concurrent label workers and are not paired deployment latency controls
A train-split shared cohort is a resubstitution diagnostic, not generalization
